#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
logs=$base/logs
out=$1
out_parent=$(dirname -- "$out")
out_name=$(basename -- "$out")

mkdir -p -- "$out_parent"
out_parent=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$out_parent" && pwd -P)
out_abs=$out_parent/$out_name

case "$out_abs" in
    "$logs"|"$logs"/*)
        printf 'output directory must not be inside %s\n' "$logs" >&2
        exit 64
        ;;
esac

if [ -L "$out_abs" ] || { [ -e "$out_abs" ] && [ ! -d "$out_abs" ]; }; then
    printf 'output path is not a directory: %s\n' "$out_abs" >&2
    exit 73
fi

if [ -d "$out_abs" ] && find "$out_abs" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    printf 'output directory is not empty: %s\n' "$out_abs" >&2
    exit 73
fi

stage=$(mktemp -d "$out_parent/.support-export.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$stage"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

find "$logs" -type d -print |
while IFS= read -r dir; do
    rel=${dir#"$logs"}
    rel=${rel#/}
    [ -n "$rel" ] || continue
    mkdir -p -- "$stage/$rel"
    chmod --reference="$dir" "$stage/$rel"
done

find "$logs" -type f -print |
while IFS= read -r src; do
    rel=${src#"$logs"/}
    dst=$stage/$rel
    sed -E         -e 's/[[:alnum:]_.%+~-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g'         -e 's/(auth_token"?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)"[^"]*"/\1"[REDACTED]"/g'         -e "s/(auth_token'?[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)'[^']*'/\\1'[REDACTED]'/g"         -e 's/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:],;}]+/\1[REDACTED]/g'         "$src" > "$dst"
    chmod --reference="$src" "$dst"
done

find "$logs" -type l -print |
while IFS= read -r link; do
    target=$(readlink -f -- "$link" 2>/dev/null || :)
    case "$target" in
        "$logs"|"$logs"/*)
            printf 'Skipping symlink in support data: %s\n' "${link#"$logs"/}" >&2
            ;;
        *)
            printf 'Rejected symlink outside logs/: %s\n' "${link#"$logs"/}" >&2
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -d "$out_abs" ]; then
    rmdir -- "$out_abs"
fi
mv -- "$stage" "$out_abs"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
chmod 755 /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
sh -n /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
sed -n '1,240p' /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
